questions.q: Write two ways to greet someone in English.
questions.a: Hello! / Hi! / Good morning! — e.g. "Hello, how are you?" and "Good afternoon!"

questions.q: How do you introduce yourself? Write a short sentence.
questions.a: "Hello, my name is Ali. I am ten years old. I am from Türkiye."
one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

questions.q: Name three places in a town.
questions.a: school, hospital, supermarket, park, cinema, museum (any three).
"Excuse me, where is the hospital, please?" / "How can I get to the bank?"

questions.q: "There is / There are" — complete: ____ a park near my house.
questions.a: "There is a park near my house." (singular → There is; plural → There are).

questions.q: Write three daily activities with the time.
questions.a: I get up at 7 o'clock. I have breakfast at 7:30. I go to school at 8 o'clock.

questions.q: Answer: "What time do you go to bed?"
Use the present simple: She (go) ____ to school every day.
questions.a: "She goes to school every day." (third person singular takes -s).

questions.q: Express likes and dislikes about a hobby.
questions.a: I like playing football. I love reading books. I don't like swimming.

questions.q: Ask: "Do you like ...?" and give a short answer.
questions.a: "Do you like pizza?" — "Yes, I do." / "No, I don't."

questions.q: Name three sports and three colours in English.
questions.a: Sports: football, basketball, swimming. Colours: red, blue, green.
